d: These alligator rescues were definitely not easy! Join Paul Bedard, Jimmy Riffle and Ashley Lawrence as they take on some of their most challenging missions as alligator trappers. This compilation brings together the best moments from Gator Boys, featuring daring attempts to rescue and remove nuisance alligators across Florida and Mississippi. From catching huge alligators in ponds and backyards to handling aggressive alligator catches, every mission demands skill, courage and precision. Watch the Everglades alligator rescue team take on dangerous relocation missions, hand-catching gators…
